topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found it tucked away, hidden beneath the old maps and forgotten photos. A novel, pages and pages, all about me. It's as if every quiet moment, every thought I've whispered into the air, has been caught and woven into this story. I read, and with each word, the room seems to shrink, the walls closing in, painting me into a corner with no way out. The person I know, the one I thought I understood, is a stranger now, crafting a life for me on paper. I can't breathe. I need to find them, to ask why, but the words stick in my throat, a thick, heavy silence.
